sources.snippet: We propose Zero-WAM with an in-context future chunk prediction objective to reduce shortcut learning and strengthen the use of human video prompts. We demonstrate zero-shot cross-task generalization in RoboTwin 2.0 and real-world unseen task configurations without collecting corresponding robot data or updating model parameters.
